title: achillea distans subsp. alpina
intro: Achillea distans subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Yarrow, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sunflower family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Yarrow include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable plant for promoting overall well-being and health.
